data.long_meaning: She who gives righteous deeds and upholds truth and justice. The name Asadaqat carries the meaning “Giver of Righteous Deeds” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Asadaqat usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of righteous deeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أسدقات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أسد و قات، يعني من يقاتل بشجاعة كالأسد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أسدقات مشتق من الجذرين اللغويين أسد و قات. أسد يعني الشجاع القوي، و قات يعني القتال أو التضحية. يوحي الاسم بالشجاعة و الصبر في مواجهة التحديات، كما يعبر عن القوة و الإقدام في الدفاع عن الحق. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة آيات تشير إلى أهمية القتال في سبيل الله، مثل قوله تعالى: 'و قاتلوا في سبيل الله الذين يقاتلونكم و لا تعتدوا إن الله لا يحب المعتدين' (البقرة: 190). يعتبر اسم أسدقات من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: اسدقات
in_urdu.meaning: اس نام کا مطلب ہے بہادری سے لڑنے والا، شیر کی طرح قتال کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسدقات نام عربی زبان کی اصطلاحات أسد و قات سے ماخوذ ہے۔ أسد کا مطلب ہے شیر اور قات کا مطلب ہے قتال کرنا۔ یہ نام بہادری، طاقت، اور حق کے لیے لڑنے کے جذبے کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، قتال في سبيل الله (اللہ کی راہ میں لڑائی) کو ایک اہم پہلو کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن میں: 'وَقَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللّهِ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَكُمْ وَلاَ تَعْتَدُوا إِنَّ اللّهَ لاَ يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ' (البقرة: 190)। یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لیے ایک اہم ثقافتی اور مذہبی معنی رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: असदक़ात
in_hindi.meaning: इस नाम का अर्थ है शेर की तरह लड़ने वाला, वीर योद्धा
in_hindi.long_meaning: असदक़ात नाम की उत्पत्ति عربی भाषा के शब्दों أسد (असद) और قات (क़ात) से हुई है। असद का अर्थ है शेर और क़ात का अर्थ है लड़ना या युद्ध करना। यह नाम वीरता, साहस और न्याय के लिए लड़ने की भावना को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, अल्लाह की राह में लड़ना एक महत्वपूर्ण पहलू माना जाता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: 'और तुम अल्लाह की राह में उन से लड़ो, जो तुम से लड़ते हैं, लेकिन अत्याचार न करो। निस्संदेह अल्लाह अत्याचारियों से प्रेम नहीं करता है' (अल-बक़रा: 190)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक महत्वपूर्ण सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक अर्थ रखता है।

in_pashto.name: اسدقات
in_pashto.meaning: د اسد او قات څخه مشتق شوی، يعنی د شير په څير جنګيدونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسدقات نوم د عربي ژبې د اسد او قات ريښو څخه اخيستل شوی دی. اسد د قوي او شجاع، او قات د جنګ يا مبارزه معنی لري. دا نوم د شجاعت، زړورتیا، او د حق لپاره د جنګيدو احساس څرګندوي. په اسلامي تړاد کې، د الله په لاره کې مبارزه يو مهم اړخ ګڼل کيږي، لکه څنګه چې قرآن کې فرمايي: 'او تاسو د الله په لاره کې د هغو کسانو سره مبارزه وکړئ، کوم چې ستاسو سره مبارزه کوي، او زياده تيري مه کوئ، بيشکه الله تعالی د تيره کارو نه خوښوي' (البقرة: 190). دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې يو مهم ثقافتي او مذهبي معنی لري.

in_english.name: Asadaqat
in_english.meaning: derived from Asad and Qat, means brave fighter or lion-like warrior
in_english.long_meaning: The name Asadaqat is derived from the Arabic roots أسد (Asad) meaning lion and قات (Qat) meaning to fight or struggle. It signifies bravery, strength, and the spirit of fighting for justice. In Islamic tradition, the concept of fighting in the way of Allah is significant, as mentioned in the Quran: 'And fight in the way of Allah those who fight you but do not transgress. Indeed. Allah does not like transgressors.' (Al-Baqara: 190). The name holds deep cultural and religious significance across Muslim communities, symbolizing courage and the pursuit of righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asadaqat is of significant importance in the Islamic world, reflecting the emphasis on integrity and justice in the teachings of Islam. The name can be seen as a reminder of the importance of righteous actions, justice, and upholding truth in daily life. It is a powerful name that embodies the moral and ethical values of the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Asadaqat represents the essence of striving for righteousness and seeking justice in the eyes of Allah. It is a reminder of the importance of truth and honesty in our actions and words. By embracing the name Asadaqat, one is embracing the values of the Islamic faith and striving to live a life that embodies these values. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of striving for righteousness, truth, and justice not only for ourselves but also for the benefit of our communities and the world around us. Asadaqat is a name that inspires us to be better people, and to live a life that aligns with the teachings of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name As-Sadaqat signifies the concept of righteous and voluntary giving in Islam. It is derived from the word sadaqah which means giving for the sake of Allah, thereby purifying one's heart and fostering a spirit of generosity and selflessness. This act of giving is a form of worship and a means to seek Allah's pleasure and reward in the hereafter.

historical_references.context: The name 'Asadaqah' or 'Asadaqat' is mentioned in the context of Zaid ibn Ali, who was the brother of Imam Husayn (as) and the governor of Kufa during the caliphate of Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). Zaid was known for his truthfulness and justice, and the name 'Asadaqah' means 'truthful' in Arabic.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri's Ansab al-Ashraf The name Asadaqat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name 'Asadaqah' was also given to a group of people during the early Islamic period who were known for their truthfulness and honesty. They were called the 'Ashab al-Asadaqah' and were prominent among the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).

modern_usage.modern_context: The term 'Asadaqat' in its modern context refers to charitable donations and philanthropic initiatives in the Islamic world. Asadaqat is increasingly being practiced through various digital platforms, including mobile apps, online marketplaces, and crowdfunding platforms. Mobile apps like 'Zakat Foundation of America' and 'LaYouth' allow users to easily calculate and pay their zakat (Islamic alms) directly from their mobile devices. Online marketplaces such as 'Souq.com' and 'Momkin' enable users to shop for items and donate a portion of their purchase to various charitable causes. Crowdfunding platforms like 'Majlis' and 'Mosacash' enable individuals and organizations to raise funds for various social impact projects, such as education, healthcare, and disaster relief.
